description: Zigbee compatible fixture with integrated occupancy sensor
exposes_summary: identify, light (state, brightness), effect, power_on_behavior, occupancy, illuminance, network_join_search_count, light_pwm_frequency, dimming_brightness_curve, start_up_on_off, motion_sensor_lux_threshold, motion_sensor_operation_mode, motion_sensor_sensitivity, motion_sensor_microwave_detection, touchlink_onoff_broadcast, brightness_module_enable, light_on_time, pwm_brightness_value, pwm_output_percentage, light_status_after_first_delay, second_delay_time, light_status_after_second_delay, linearity_error_ratio_lux, fixed_deviation_lux, action

exposes.name: Identify
exposes.description: Initiate device identification.

exposes.name: Effect
exposes.description: Triggers an effect on the light (e.g. make light blink for a few seconds).

exposes.name: Power-on behavior
exposes.description: Controls the behavior when the device is powered on after power loss.

exposes.name: Occupancy
exposes.description: Indicates whether the device detected occupancy.

exposes.name: Illuminance
exposes.description: Measured illuminance.

exposes.name: Network join search count
exposes.description: How many times will the device search and join a Zigbee network, searching every 15 seconds. Default: 2 (1~255, 255 means always searching).

exposes.name: Light pwm frequency
exposes.description: Light PWM Frequency. Works after reset power of the device. DO NOT set the PWM frequency too high which will affect the dimming resolution. Default: 3300.

exposes.name: Dimming brightness curve
exposes.description: Dimming brightness curve. Options: linear, gamma 1.5, gamma 1.8. Default: linear..

exposes.name: Start up on off
exposes.description: Device power-on state. Options: off, on, restore previous state. Default: restore previous state..

exposes.name: Motion sensor lux threshold
exposes.description: Daylight sensor lux threshold. When the measured lux is below this value, the light is allowed to turn on. Set to minimum value to disable this function. Default: disabled..

exposes.name: Motion sensor operation mode
exposes.description: Motion sensor operation mode. Options: auto (PWM output on motion), manual (PWM controlled by gateway or switch). Default: auto..

exposes.name: Motion sensor sensitivity
exposes.description: Motion sensor sensitivity. 0 is highest sensitivity, 15 is lowest. Default: 1..

exposes.name: Motion sensor microwave detection
exposes.description: Enable or disable microwave detection. Options: enabled, disabled. Default: enabled..

exposes.name: Touchlink onoff broadcast
exposes.description: Send ON/OFF command to touchlink or binding devices. Options: send, do not send. Default: send..

exposes.name: Brightness module enable
exposes.description: Enable or disable the brightness module. Options: enabled, disabled. Default: enabled..

exposes.name: Light on time
exposes.description: Light on time (first delay). When motion is detected and then the area is vacated, this is the time the light stays on. Unit: seconds. Default: 60 seconds..

exposes.name: Pwm brightness value
exposes.description: Brightness value for PWM output when motion is detected. 0 disables this function. Default: disabled..

exposes.name: Pwm output percentage
exposes.description: PWM output percentage when motion is detected. Range: 0-100%. Default: 100%..

exposes.name: Light status after first delay
exposes.description: Light status after the first delay expires, during the second delay. Range: 0-100%. Default: 0% (off)..

exposes.name: Second delay time
exposes.description: Duration of the second delay after the first delay expires. Unit: seconds. Default: 60 seconds..

exposes.name: Light status after second delay
exposes.description: Light status after the second delay expires. Range: 0-100%. Default: 0% (off)..

exposes.name: Linearity error ratio lux
exposes.description: Linearity error ratio coefficient for LUX measurement. 1000 means 1000‰ (default). Increasing this value magnifies the LUX measurement linearly, decreasing minifies it. For example, 1001 means 1.001x, 500 means 0.5x..

exposes.name: Fixed deviation lux
exposes.description: Fixed deviation of LUX measurement. Signed 2-byte integer. Positive value increases, negative value decreases the measured LUX. For example, 100 means +100 LUX, -100 means -100 LUX..

exposes.name: Action
exposes.description: Triggered action (e.g. a button click).
